description: This file implements the t_string class, which manages translatable strings with serialization/deserialization, translation, and concatenation functionalities, including handling of text domains for localization.

classes.name: t_string
classes.description: A class representing translatable strings with serialization, deserialization, and concatenation support, including handling of text domains for localization.

classes.name: t_string::walker
classes.description: A helper class for iterating over parts of a t_string, identifying translatable segments and their associated text domains.

methods.name: from_serialized
methods.description: Creates a t_string object from a serialized string, reconstructing translatable segments.

methods.name: to_serialized
methods.description: Serializes the t_string object into a string with translatable segments marked.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operators for copying from another t_string, or assigning from std::string or C-string.

methods.name: str
methods.description: Returns the string representation, performing translation if needed.

methods.name: c_str
methods.description: Returns C-string representation of the string.

methods.name: add_textdomain
methods.description: Binds a text domain to a specified path for localization.
